caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical floral motif with vibrant colors on a beige background. At the center, there is a tall, red flower with a large circular bloom at the top, consisting of numerous yellow dots inside a red circular outline, sitting atop a red stalk with branching leaves. To the left and right of the central stalk, there are two large, star-shaped flowers. Each star is comprised of alternating red and yellow triangular points, with a blue and white striped oval disk at the center, bordered with zigzag and solid lines in yellow and blue. Below the central flower, two yellow, tulip-shaped blooms face outward, each with a blue zigzag pattern inside. At the bottom, there is a red horizontal element with downward-hanging, petal-like shapes and blue wavy lines beneath it. The composition uses primarily red, yellow, and blue against a plain background. There are also some small fragments of text in the bottom margin.
title: Drawing for Plate 11: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
